design_philosophy: A deeply Spanish, premium language learning hub. It blends the warmth of terracotta, ivory, and traditional Gaudi/Talavera mosaics with the bold energy of the Spanish flag (Red & Gold). We use 'Optical Clarity' glassmorphism over Mediterranean textures to create a cozy but high-end 'private tutor' feel. Maximum 660px width creates a focused, app-like experience on desktop.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle border on cards, matching the border color to ground them.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use smooth transitions: 'transition-all duration-300 ease-out' for hovers. Use Framer Motion for stagger animations on the 15-drill grid.
visual_enhancers.decorative_elements: Incorporate subtle background images of Gaudi mosaic or Terracotta plaster on the global wrapper, shining through the 660px glassmorphism container.

global_background_light.description: Warm terracotta textured plaster wall, soft golden hour sunlight. Use as the fixed background for the entire page (behind the 660px container) in light mode.

global_background_dark.description: Abstract elegant geometric background inspired by the Spanish flag, dark mode friendly. Use as fixed background for dark mode.

category_card_pattern.description: Spanish tile pattern, terracotta, ivory, and faded blue. Use as subtle 10% opacity overlay on drill cards or category headers.

hero_spain_madrid.description: Scenic panorama of Madrid's rooftops at sunset. Great for the 'Done screen' or 'Mastery progress' hero image.

mosaic_accent.description: Barcelona Gaudi mosaic. Use as a beautiful avatar background or leaderboard banner overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce the 660px max-width container for the main app content. The 'body' or root should have the 'global_background_light' or 'global_background_dark' spanning the full screen, while the app container is centered with glassmorphic styles.
Use Lucide-react for icons by default.
Install and use 'framer-motion' for staggered entrance animations of the 15 drill cards.
Headings MUST be Playfair Display, Body MUST be Inter. Import them from Google Fonts in index.css.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF for backgrounds. Use the provided tinted terracotta/cream hex codes.
Ensure the header is sticky and uses a high-blur glass effect (backdrop-blur-xl) so the content passing underneath is smoothly obscured.
For the daily streak, use the secondary color (#F5C518 - Gold) to make it pop against the terracotta/cream.
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='drill-card-1', data-testid='start-quiz-btn').
Replace standard HTML inputs/selects with custom Shadcn UI (modified to match E1's rounded, warm borders). Use border-radius 'xl' for a friendly, approachable feel.
The 15 Drill Cards should use E1's 'Bento Grid' protocol but adapted for 660px: grid-cols-1 or sm:grid-cols-2 with generous gap-4 or gap-6.
